# Goban Studio v1.0.0

A complete, offline Go application for macOS and Windows.

## Play

- Standard 19×19 board by default, with 9×9 and 13×13 for teaching and quick games
- Japanese rules only: territory + prisoners + komi, dead-stone confirmation
- Komi, handicap, pass, resign, undo, hints and human-vs-human play
- KataGo 19×19 sidecar with five visit budgets, plus the bundled Moka 9×9 net

## Learn

- 60 lessons: 20 foundation lessons and 40 reading-practice positions
- 40 professional opening layouts, each drawn from a real game
- 20 classic games with four-language notes and SGF replay
- 300 tsumego drills with spaced review
- Chinese, English, Korean and Japanese interface and content

## Records

- SGF import/export, file associations, saved games and review
- Offline by design: no account, network request or telemetry

## Packages

- macOS arm64: zip and dmg, adhoc signed, KataGo Eigen sidecar included
- Windows x64: zip, KataGo Eigen sidecar and its runtime DLLs included

KataGo is MIT licensed. The b6c96 network is distributed with KataGo.
